column3: MT 61:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm” to the title.
Close to the Hebrew; בַּעֲטֹף (“grows faint”) is rendered “is overwhelmed.”
Close to the Hebrew; מַחְסֶה (“a refuge”) is rendered “a shelter.”
Close to the Hebrew; “tent” is rendered “tabernacle,” and “take refuge” “trust.”
Close to the Hebrew; יְרֻשַּׁת (“the inheritance”) is rendered “the heritage,” and NKJV supplies “me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you will add days to the days of the king” is rendered “You will prolong the king’s life.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty and faithfulness” is rendered “mercy and truth,” and מַן (“appoint”) “prepare.”
